model.name: LFM2.5-230M
model.quantization: BF16 weights, F32 dense compute; ternary-v1 packed variant added in iteration 002

measurement.memoryScope: Whole process (max RSS via /usr/bin/time -l). F32-expanded weights alone are ~0.86 GiB by allocation math; KV cache at 1024 tokens is ~24 MiB.
measurement.notes: Iteration 001 (baseline): cold-start CLI, parses ~438 MiB BF16 safetensors and expands to F32. TTFT includes model load plus prompt processing. Output speed = (32−1 tokens) / (t₃₂ − t₁) = 31 / 10.95 s. Correctness: llama.cpp b11046 CPU f32-KV oracle, 118/118 teacher-forced positions top-1 agreement, max abs logit delta 0.33; 330/332 generated ids agree, both disagreements at near-ties. Iteration 002 (ternary packed path): correctness gate is bitwise — packed_linear/packed_gather_rows and the fully packed executor produce identical logits to the dequantized minifield.ternary.v1 weights through the dense path (fixture vectors + generated 2-layer model + multi-group rows). Real-artifact run: packed safetensors (58.3 MiB) loads in 0.42 s vs dense (438.2 MiB) in 3.39 s (parse+decode+upload from memory); a 26-token teacher-forced pass runs 6.74 s packed vs 8.82 s dense (3.71 vs 2.84 tokens/s decode-equivalent, ~270 vs ~353 ms/token). Packed codes stay U8 in RAM so resident weights track file size; dense expands to F32 (~0.86 GiB). Speedup is weight-bandwidth, not kernel math — the scalar kernel does the same MAC count plus unpacking. Quality caveat: naive absmax-RTN ternary gives 0/26 top-1 agreement vs dense (max logit delta ~24) — expected for 230M without QAT; quality is a training-side concern, the runtime path itself is bit-exact vs its own dequantization. Iteration 003 (wgpu F32 backend): new engines/backend-wgpu crate runs the full dense model on GPU. Correctness gate is bitwise — 12/12 teacher-forced top-1 positions match CPU with max logit delta 0.0000 on the real bundle. Measured: wgpu load (device init + F32 upload) 3.89 s vs CPU 3.16 s; 12-token teacher-forced run 0.53 s vs 4.02 s (20.9 vs 2.87 tokens/s decode-equivalent, ~48 vs ~365 ms/token) — 7.7x on GPU before any fusion or quantization, despite ~240 recorded dispatches/token. Op-level parity: 12/12 tests vs backend-cpu on Metal. Iteration 004 (NEON SIMD ternary matvec): new crates/kernels-simd provides the packed-linear inner dot; scoped-unsafe NEON on aarch64, scalar fallback elsewhere. Correctness gate relaxed from bitwise to declared reorder tolerance 1e-4 (observed ~1e-6) since SIMD changes f32 accumulation order; all products stay exact. Gather/decode stays bitwise. Measured on the real packed bundle: 26-token teacher-forced run 0.96 s vs 6.74 s scalar (7.0x, 25.99 vs 3.71 tokens/s decode-equivalent) and vs 8.68 s dense (9.0x). Packed top-1 token sequence is identical to the scalar run, so reorder changed no argmax. AVX2 and the persistent thread pool remain open; wasm32 SIMD128 is T6.

evidence: Oracle gate: crates/executor-core/tests/oracle_lfm25.rs @ c3400ba (env-gated, MINIFIELD_LFM25_BUNDLE_DIR + MINIFIELD_LFM25_ORACLE_DIR). Capture tooling: scripts/oracle/ @ c3400ba. Oracle: llama.cpp b11046 CPU-only, f32 KV, temp 0, 6 prompts, artifacts hashed in tmp/oracle/manifest.json. Timing: /usr/bin/time -l on minifield-infer, prompt 'Tell me about yourself.', BOS on. Iteration 002 evidence: crates/executor-core/tests/packed_ternary.rs on branch ternary/t4-packed-linear (committed fixture crates/executor-core/tests/fixtures/ternary-v1-001/ + generated in-memory model); real-artifact run env-gated on MINIFIELD_LFM25_PACKED=tmp/models/lfm2.5-230m/lfm2.5-230m-ternary-v1.safetensors (61,132,272 B, produced by training/ sample exporter on branch ternary-export-v1) vs model.safetensors (459,401,112 B). Load timings measure parse+decode+upload from in-memory bytes, file IO excluded. Iteration 003 evidence: engines/backend-wgpu (wgpu 30.0.1) tests/parity.rs (12 ops, Metal adapter) and tests/executor_parity.rs (env-gated MINIFIELD_LFM25_BUNDLE_DIR, real model.safetensors, wgpu vs cpu teacher-forced logits). Timings from Instant around load and run inside the release test. Iteration 004 evidence: crates/kernels-simd (NEON group dot via vld4-deinterleaved f32 path) wired into backend-cpu packed_linear; crates/executor-core/tests/packed_ternary.rs tolerance gate REORDER_TOLERANCE=1e-4 (gather stays bitwise); real-artifact run env-gated as in iteration 002, release build.
